project_info.description: Template metadata demonstrating every segmentation_metadata.json parameter across all three segmentation methods. Batch 1 shows 'dl' (Segformer-based) and 'cl' (classical) runs; batch 2 shows 'orgline' only, so every method is represented.
project_info._comment: Within one batch, every run's 'days' list must be disjoint from every other run's -- segmentation output is written to processed_data/Day <day>/<batch>/ (see utils_segmentation.py), keyed by day and batch (never by run name). 'expected_organoid_counts' can be set both on a batch (a default, e.g. for a day with no run-specific override) and on an individual run (overrides the batch's value for that same day, else adds a day the batch-level dict didn't cover).

segmentation_runs.name: early_96well_dl
segmentation_runs._comment: 'dl' (Segformer-based deep-learning segmentation; aliases: 'model'/'segmentation_model' keys, 'deep_learning'/'deeplearning'/'neural'/'nn' values). 'num_plates' is omitted here, so this run inherits the batch's own value (2) -- see the late run below for the override case. checkpoint/model_config_path left null to fall back to experiment_info.py's own defaults -- set them to override the model/checkpoint used for this run specifically. erosion/dilation kernels are 0 (disabled) by default.

segmentation_runs.name: late_24well_classical_multi
segmentation_runs._comment: 'cl' (classical threshold+contour segmentation; aliases: 'classical'/'classic'/'threshold'/'traditional'). 'num_plates': 1 overrides the batch's default of 2 -- only one of the two plates from the early run above continued to this later timepoint. organoids_per_image: 'multiple' (aliases: 'organoid_mode'/'multiple_organoids' keys; accepts 'multi'/'many'/'true'/'yes') keeps every contour surviving the filters per stitched image, for multi-organoid wells. tile_order accepts 'serpentine'/'snake'/'d_order' (default), 'row'/'row_major' (shown here), 'column'/'column_major', or 'column_snake'/'vertical_snake'. threshold accepts an int 0-255 or the literal string 'otsu' to resolve a fresh Otsu cutoff per image. center_fraction/close_kernel_size are classical-only: center_fraction masks out everything beyond this fraction of the image width (approximating the physical well edge); close_kernel_size bridges small gaps in an object's boundary via morphological closing before area/circularity filtering. track_light_dark_split (aliases: 'track_core_rim_split'/'has_cystic_organoids'/'cystic_organoids') enables per-organoid light-vs-dark area estimation from each mask's own grayscale histogram -- light_dark_min_eta_squared is the minimum variance-explained fraction for that split to be trusted instead of treated as an artifact; light_dark_overlay_color is the RGB color used for the light class in the rendered classification overlay images (dark is always white, background always black).

segmentation_runs.name: early_96well_orgline
segmentation_runs._comment: OrgLine (detector-guided SAM2 prompting; aliases: 'model'/'segmentation_model' keys, 'org_line'/'orgdet'/'orgline_tiny' values), an alternative to 'dl'/'cl'. Runs under this tool's own main environment, same as 'dl'/'cl' -- no separate venv or switching needed (see ../../environments/README.md). orgline_repo/orgdet_checkpoint/sam2_checkpoint left null here to default to ../../environments/OrgLine's own clone/checkpoints -- set them only if your clone lives elsewhere. organoids_per_image: 'single' keeps only OrgLine's single highest-confidence detection per image; 'multiple' keeps every detection surviving orgline_conf/orgline_iou -- see the late run below for a multi-organoid, stitched example.

segmentation_runs.name: late_24well_orgline_multi
segmentation_runs._comment: Orgline_conf/orgline_iou are the detector's confidence/NMS-IoU thresholds, tuned slightly looser here than the early run's defaults for the more crowded multi-organoid case; orgline_imgsz/orgline_agnostic_nms are omitted, so they keep their defaults (640, false) -- see the early run's own comment for what those mean.
